tag.en: 🚶 Walk-in: no booking, the salon is busy
tag.vi: 🚶 Khách vãng lai: không hẹn trước, tiệm đang đông

occasion: You walked in without a booking while the salon is busy.
constraints: Ask if they can squeeze you in and how long the wait is. You get annoyed if nobody tells you the wait time; you calm down when the stylist apologises, gives a clear wait time, and offers you a seat or a quicker option.
openingLine: Hi, I don't have an appointment. Can you squeeze me in? How long is the wait?
